specGaps.question: Which discount codes exist and what they are worth. The brief names none; WELCOME10 (10% of Standard) was found by probing.
Refund at exactly 24 h before start: 100% or 50%? The table uses 'more than' and 'within', so exactly 24 h falls in 'within' (50%).
Is the service fee refunded? The brief says 100% refund; the system refunds the total including the fee.
Is the VIP cap per event or per order across events? The brief says 'one order', so the cap is per order across all events.
Can the cart hold more tickets than remain in stock? Not stated; stock is checked (or not) at checkout.
Does changing the password end existing sessions? Not stated.
Is a whitespace-only recipient name valid? Not stated; treated as invalid (empty).
Can the 50% refund tier be exercised? Only an admin can create an event starting within 24 h; no such event exists in this environment.
"Discount codes apply to Standard tickets": only to Standard, or to Standard among others? Read here as only, which BUG-06 depends on.
